question: Are there a sandwich restaurant situated within 20 kilometers of Baptist Arlington Emergency Department, Arlington, TN?
sql: SELECT 1 FROM pois AS sandwich_restaurants WHERE sandwich_restaurants.cuisine ILIKE '%sandwich%' AND sandwich_restaurants.amenity ILIKE '%restaurant%' AND ST_DWithin(sandwich_restaurants.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Baptist Arlington Emergency Department%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 20000) LIMIT 1;
